name: In Search of Thaelrid
summary: In Search of Thaelrid is an Alliance reconnaissance mission dispatched from Darnassus on behalf of the Argent Dawn. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass tasks adventurers with venturing into the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps to locate a missing scout who vanished while investigating a dangerous alliance between naga and cultists. It represents an early encounter with the reach of the Argent Dawn beyond their typical northern vigil.

sections.title: Eyes in the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Though the Argent Dawn is most renowned for holding the line against the Scourge in the plague-ridden ruins of Lordaeron, its vigilance extends across Kalimdor. Stationed within Darnassus, Dawnwatcher Shaedlass gathers whispers and intelligence on unnatural threats emerging across the world. When unsettling reports arose that sea-dwelling naga and the doomsday zealots of the Twilight's Hammer had forged a pact within the flooded chambers of Blackfathom Deeps along the Ashenvale shore, the order recognized the potential catastrophe.

sections.title: The Missing Scout
sections.body: To assess the veracity of these coastal rumors, Shaedlass dispatched Argent Guard Thaelrid to quietly infiltrate the subterranean caverns. Weeks passed without word, leaving the Dawnwatcher in the dark with his other scouts committed to separate operations. Fearing that Thaelrid had either fallen in battle or been captured by the dark powers dwelling beneath the waves, he enlists seasoned travelers brave enough to breach Blackfathom Deeps and bring him back alive.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn interested in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn monitors all existential, corrupting threats across Azeroth, not just the undead of the Eastern Kingdoms. The prospect of ancient naga collaborating with fanatical cultists of the Twilight's Hammer within Kalimdor represents a destabilizing evil that demands their attention.

Dawnwatcher Shaedlass is an Argent Dawn operative stationed within the night elf capital of Darnassus. His primary duty is information gathering, identifying where the order's aid is urgently required and dispatching investigators to evaluate regional crises.

Argent Guard Thaelrid is an operative of the Argent Dawn sent to conduct reconnaissance on Blackfathom Deeps. His mission was to determine the true strength and intent of the cultists and naga residing within the drowned caverns.

Argent Guard Thaelrid has successfully infiltrated the subterranean depths of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, though he remains isolated deep within the caverns awaiting reinforcements.

Upon being located, Thaelrid reveals the full, insidious nature of the ritual underway inside the ruins, immediately directing adventurers toward a strike against the cult's leadership in the quest Blackfathom Villainy.

faq.q: Can Horde players take this mission?
faq.answer: No. The assignment is given by Dawnwatcher Shaedlass directly in Darnassus, making it an Alliance expedition, though Thaelrid himself holds no love for evil whether encountered by Horde or Alliance.

angles.text: This mission marks one of the earliest opportunities for Alliance adventurers to establish goodwill and service alongside the Argent Dawn.
The desecration of the ancient Temple of Elune within Blackfathom Deeps makes assisting the Argent Dawn an urgent matter of recovering sacred night elven heritage.
Paladins aligned with the Argent Dawn recognize Thaelrid's solitary vigil as a solemn duty to protect the world from creeping shadow and corruption.
